verdict.rationale: Mirrors ingests agent traces, so this axis applies. The evidence never mentions OpenTelemetry or OTLP for sending or receiving traces. Capture runs through its own npm SDK hooks that upload snapshots, and the generic claim that it 'works with the traces I already have' does not name a format or protocol, so OTLP support is undocumented.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send and receive traces over OpenTelemetry (OTLP) instead of a proprietary format
